name: A0 — Land in-flight branches and freeze the linter rule set
description:
**Slice 1/8 of the rule-unification track** (`addon-repository-actions-config` repo, `doc/plans/rule-unification-a0.md`). Track index: `shoptet/partner-cli` repo, `doc/plans/rule-unification.md`. Next slice: A1.

### Why this is its own slice

Three open branches are editing the exact rule config/severities/`profiles.js` that A1/A2 will port and extract. Extracting a moving target makes "preserve existing functionality" undefined. The branch that matters most is `fix/large-file-inline-comments`, which changes the severity → gate mapping and promotes `max-lines` from recommendation to blocker — both layers the shared packages will own.

### Scope

- Land or close each open branch (`fix/large-file-inline-comments`, `fix/merge-audit-base-branch-guard`, `node22-update`, `webpack`, `feature/ai-review-skill`). For any not landed, record why in the PR.

  - `node22-update` cannot land as-is: its `default.workflow.yml` hardcodes `node-version: '22'` with no `node_version` input, while `main` (after PR #13) exposes the input with default `'24'`. Cherry-pick the `actions/*`/artifact-upload-v5 bumps instead, or close and reopen separately.
  - `feature/ai-review-skill` is out of scope for the CLI track but touches `rules-catalog.md`, whose codes (A1, B5, C4, H1) the rule comments cite.
- Take a **rule-set snapshot** after landing: the exact `rule@severity` set the gate produces, from `test/selftest.js` + `test-cases/expected.json`. This is the baseline A1 preserves and A2 publishes.
- Re-run the selftest, confirm green on `main`.
- Decide and record the `max-lines` question: if `fix/large-file-inline-comments` lands, `@shoptet/addon-eslint-config` ships `max-lines` as a blocker at 400 lines from v1 — a partner-visible gate change that belongs in the snapshot.

### Definition of done

- No open branch modifies `linter_review_tool/` rule config, severities, or `profiles.js`.
- `node test/selftest.js` green on `main`; the resulting `rule@severity` set is written down in the PR as the frozen baseline.
- README's Node-version inconsistency fixed (one paragraph still says `node_version` default is `'22'`, while `default.workflow.yml` sets `'24'` after PR #13).

### Review checklist

- Frozen baseline produced by _running_ the selftest, not by reading `expected.json`.
- No branch left open with rule-config changes in it.
- `default.workflow.yml` still exposes `node_version` with default `'24'`.
- Baseline includes stylelint and HTML findings, not just ESLint.
